data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Zendesk Messaging SDK, enabling in-app chat with JWT auth.
data.what_it_does: Provides a native messaging UI for Zendesk, supporting multi-conversation navigation, real-time event streaming, and JWT authentication. It also handles push notifications and locale overrides.
use_when: You need Zendesk in-app chat with real-time updates
You want to display Zendesk conversations or start new ones from Flutter
avoid_when: You don't use Zendesk or need a generic chat solution
You need a lightweight, no-native-setup chat widget
strengths: Real-time event stream with 24 event types
weaknesses: Requires native Android/iOS setup (Maven repo, Podfile)
Plugin only, no pure Dart alternative
data.setup_notes: Add Maven repo to android/build.gradle, set iOS platform to 14.0 in Podfile, run pod install or use Swift Package Manager. No build_runner needed.
